mission: Provide a local-first AI agent platform that runs on hardware the operator controls, with persistent identity, memory, and voice.
purpose: OtaconsKeep ships Otacon Core (Lite) as the free foundation; Expansion and Keep Desk / KeepRoute / AI9 are related public products. The private Reference Keep demonstrates deeper media, home, and multi-node capabilities that are not claimed as downloadable clones.
operational_concept: Operator installs Core locally (Windows one-click via OtaconsKeep-Setup.bat or Linux/WSL), receives a Command Center with Codec chat, optional Default Model via Ollama sized to VRAM, and Genome Voice Trainer. Agents persist conversation and long-term memory on local storage. Optional integrations (Discord, Home Assistant, ARR/media) use operator-owned credentials.

in_scope_public: Otacon Expansion (licensed; Aria + Deck/Codec installable today)
out_of_scope_or_reference_only: Private Reference Keep 16+ agent canon as a downloadable product
Full multi-node GPU media farm as automatic Expansion READY
Antonio's private infrastructure accounts or secrets

deployment_models.name: Lite on Windows
deployment_models.notes: OtaconsKeep-Setup.bat; WSL2 path; reboot/resume supported. End-to-end release-gate confirmation still partial per public Otacon page honesty notes.

deployment_models.name: Expansion on Core
deployment_models.notes: Aria chat + Deck/Codec today; Genome/Video Studio optional GPU/Docker sidecars — not automatic READY on every fresh PC.

major_capabilities: Persistent agents with identity and memory
Local Ollama chat model selection by VRAM
Optional mood and relationship continuity (Expansion / Reference Keep depth)
REX proposal → approve → execute → verify lifecycle (Reference Keep / executor; not claimed as Lite-only public surface)

lite_premium_boundaries.Lite: Free, open-source foundation — no license key, no artificial time gate.
lite_premium_boundaries.Expansion: Licensed multi-agent layer on Core; Aria + Deck/Codec installable; Genome/Video Studio optional.
lite_premium_boundaries.Reference Keep: Private depth reference — not a public downloadable clone.

external_systems.name: ARR / Seerr stack
external_systems.role: Optional media request (Reference Keep / Albedo paths)

major_actors: Agents (Aria and Expansion roster; larger roster in Reference Keep)
assumptions: Operator owns the machine and local credentials
NVIDIA GPU improves local model tier but Lite can run CPU/small-model path under 6GB VRAM
Windows WSL2 feature enable may require reboot and long OS setup time
constraints: Public Engineering portal must not expose secrets, private IPs, tokens, or sensitive logs
Do not claim Reference Keep features as Lite defaults
Do not invent verification PASS without evidence records
